lines.en: label dormwarssixmaya1:
scene dormwarssixmaya1
After spending most of the day refusing to give up on something, Niki Nakayama’s rampage through the loves of her lover continued. Which made her view herself as either George, Lizzie, or Ralph.
lines.zh: 在花费了大半天拒绝放弃某件事之后，Niki Nakayama 对她爱人所爱之人的横冲直撞仍在继续。这让她把自己看作是 George、Lizzie 或 Ralph。

lines.en: If you haven’t been around very long, those names probably don’t mean anything to you. But those were the names given to the three main characters of the 1986 arcade game “Rampage” created by Midway.
lines.zh: 如果你入行不久，这些名字对你大概毫无意义。但那三个名字，是 Midway 于 1986 年推出的街机游戏《Rampage》三位主角的名字。

lines.en: It was the first video game Niki remembered playing — at an arcade she visited before Akira Arakawa ever even walked into her life.
lines.zh: 那是 Niki 记得自己玩过的第一款电子游戏——在一家街机厅，远在 Akira Arakawa 走进她的生活之前。

lines.en: She was different then, but not by much. She had a temper that hadn’t been tempered yet. And her rage would manifest internally as she hadn’t yet found someone worth aiming it at.
lines.zh: 那时的她不一样，但也差不多少。她有着一股尚未被磨平的脾气。而她的怒火只是在内部翻涌，因为她还没找到一个值得瞄准的对象。

lines.en: That’s probably why she took to Rampage immediately, for it’s a game where all you do is destroy. And it was a game she was actually  living now that everyone else felt like skyscrapers.
lines.zh: 这大概就是她立刻就迷上《Rampage》的原因，毕竟那游戏里你唯一要做的就是破坏。而当其他所有人都像摩天大楼一样时，这游戏成了她真正在过的日子。

lines.en: What she didn’t quite understand, however, was that there was someone else with so much of their formative identity tied up in a single concept that seeing outside of the lines would best be done with them covered by duct tape.
lines.zh: 然而她并不太明白的是，还有另一个人，其身份认同被牢牢绑在单一的概念上，以至于想要看清那条线之外，最好先被人用胶带把眼睛蒙上。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya2
For the girl she had chased out here, that feeling was insignificance. Living under the shadow of some imposing mountain that always blocked out the sun when she most wanted to see it.
lines.zh: 对那个被她一路追到这里的女孩而言，那种感觉是无足轻重。生活在某座压迫性巨山的阴影下，每当她最想看见太阳，那山总是把太阳遮住。

lines.en: scene black
scene dormwarssixmaya3
That’s why she moved to the opposite side — where the grass was greener and she could watch the sunrise every morning.
lines.zh: 所以她搬到了相反的一侧——那里的草更绿，每天清晨都能看日出。

lines.en: But she’d always known that the person she moved there with would become homesick one day. That he’d tire of the sunrise and how it burns his skin, then seek out the darkness once more.
lines.zh: 可她一直清楚，跟她一起搬过去的那个人总有一天会想家。他会厌倦日出和它灼烧皮肤的方式，然后再次去寻找黑暗。

lines.en: Maya Makinami did not have a 1986 arcade cabinet with which to quell her rage, though. So she settled for the next best thing.
lines.zh: 然而 Maya Makinami 并没有一台 1986 年的街机柜来平息她的怒火。所以她退而求其次。

lines.en: A girl who looked like the girl she wanted to hate. One who faced the same struggles she did, but with an added layer of difficulty at the hands that tightened familial ties.
lines.zh: 一个长得像她想憎恨的那个女孩的女孩。一个面对着与她相同的挣扎，却因为血缘之手的收紧而多了一层难度的女孩。

lines.en: It was easier to project her insecurities over someone just as small. Someone she had already surpassed. So she just kept doing it.
lines.zh: 把不安投射到一个同样渺小的人身上要容易得多。一个她早已超越的人。于是她就一直这么做。

lines.en: But there was always an element of fear to that when the shadow Maya feared most was not just hovering behind her newfound rival, but attached to her instead.
lines.zh: 但那样做总带着一丝恐惧，因为她最惧怕的那道阴影不仅盘旋在她新晋对手的身后，而是就附在她身上。

lines.en: Noriko was the omen. She signaled the end of days without even knowing it. She signaled the sheer possibility that they may come. But now those days were upon us. Upon her.
lines.zh: Noriko 是那个凶兆。她甚至浑然不知地预告了末日的到来。她预示了末日来临的可能。而现在那些日子已经降临到我们头上。降临到她头上。

lines.en: And yet she still couldn’t face them. And no amount of emphasizing her best qualities could ever change that, so they were all just swallowed by the mountain’s darkness.
lines.zh: 可她还是无法面对。再怎么强调她最优秀的品质也改变不了这一点，于是那些品质全被山的黑暗吞没了。

lines.en: She looks out at a wall within a wall and wonders if it would feel the same if only walls could think.
lines.zh: 她望向一层墙里的一层墙，心想，倘若墙会思考，感觉会不会一样。

lines.en: But if they could, would they too get lost in thoughts like this when there’s so much more on the outside than there is here?
lines.zh: 可如果墙会思考，当外面的世界比这里丰富那么多时，它们是否也会陷入这样的念头里？

lines.en: That thought ended prematurely. As would she under the watchful eyes of an encroaching moon.
lines.zh: 那个念头戛然而止。就像在一轮步步逼近的月亮的注视下，她也会如此一样。

lines.en: : Want an autograph? I brought a pen.
lines.zh: ：要签名吗？我带了笔。

lines.en: : Did he put you up to this? Or do you just take joy in asserting superiority over vulnerable teenage girls?
lines.zh: ：是他指使你来的？还是你只是乐于在脆弱的少女身上彰显优越感？

lines.en: : He told me not to talk to you, actually. Something about you being “different,” whatever that means.
lines.zh: ：其实他叫我别跟你说话。说你「不一样」之类的，我也不知道什么意思。

lines.en: : And yet you’ve come here of your own volition. To make me feel weak so that you will feel stronger and better about falling for a serial adulterer.
lines.zh: ：可你还是自己来了。来让我觉得自己弱小，这样你就能感觉更强，也能更安心地爱上一个惯犯。

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: ：差不多吧，是的。

lines.en: : Well, then you can take solace in knowing that you don’t need to talk to me in order to do that. I’ve been second to you for as long as I’ve known him. And I’ll stay that way until he finally decides to leave me.
lines.zh: ：那么你可以放心了——你不需要跟我说话也能做到这点。从我认识他起，我就一直排在你后面。而我会一直这样，直到他终于决定离开我。

lines.en: : You’re friends with Ami, aren’t you? I’ve seen you at the house before.
lines.zh: ：你跟 Ami 是朋友，对吧？我以前在房子里见过你。

lines.en: : It was better before you were there.
lines.zh: ：你没来之前那里更好。

lines.en: : Is that why you ran away during Christmalloween a couple years back? You were having so much fun that you couldn’t contain your joy and it all exploded out of you like some sort of supernova?
lines.zh: ：这就是你几年前 Christmalloween 期间逃跑的原因吗？你玩得太开心，开心到装不下，然后像超新星一样全爆发出来了？

lines.en: : How nice of you to remember me.
lines.zh: ：你还记得我，真贴心。

lines.en: : I read all of the Haruhi books. I’d remember her anywhere.
lines.zh: ：我读过所有的 Haruhi 系列小说。她走到哪儿我都认得出。

lines.en: : Then go back inside and remember her there. You have nothing to gain here if your only purpose is to make me feel terrible about myself.
lines.zh: ：那就回屋里去，在那儿记住她吧。如果你的唯一目的就是让我觉得自己很糟，那你在这儿什么也得不到。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya4
: I wouldn’t say that’s my purpose. It’s more of just a bonus. And I bet half of the people sleeping with Akira right now wouldn’t be if they’d known how he is from the start.
lines.zh: ：我不会说那是我的目的。那更像是附带的收获。而且我敢打赌，现在正跟 Akira 上床的人里，有一半要是从一开始就知道他是什么样，就不会那样了。

lines.en: : You do seem different, though. Like a...less pink Noriko. The kind of girl who fights a losing battle with her head held high out of desperation or forced optimism or whatever it is that keeps you going.
lines.zh: ：不过你确实看起来不太一样。就像……一个不那么粉的 Noriko。那种出于绝望或强行乐观，或者不管什么支撑着你前进的东西，仰着头打一场必败之仗的女孩。

lines.en: : What do you think he sees in you, exactly? Emotionally, I mean. You’re obviously very cute.
lines.zh: ：你觉得他到底看上了你什么？我是说情感上。你显然非常可爱。

lines.en: : I used to think it was salvation. I’m not sure if that’s the case anymore, though.
lines.zh: ：我以前以为是救赎。现在我不好说还是不是了。

lines.en: : Are you saying you think he’s been saved already? Or just beyond saving?
lines.zh: ：你是说你觉得他已经得救了？还是说已经无药可救？

lines.en: : Anyone who thinks he can be “saved” doesn’t understand him at all.
lines.zh: ：任何认为他能被「拯救」的人，都完全不了解他。

lines.en: : Guess it all depends on what definition of “saved” you’re using.
lines.zh: ：那大概得看你用的是哪个「拯救」的定义了。

lines.en: : Like, I don’t think he’ll ever be happy with who he is and what he’s done, but I do think it’s possible that he lives a fulfilling and enjoyable life without fucking things up even more.
lines.zh: ：比如说，我不觉得他会对自己是谁、自己做过什么感到满意，但我觉得他有可能过上充实而愉快的生活，而不是把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: : Is that your master plan then? Get him to give everyone else up so he can live a “fulfilling and enjoyable” life with you?
lines.zh: ：那这就是你的大计吗？让他放弃其他所有人，好跟你过上「充实而愉快」的生活？

lines.en: : I don’t really know what my plan is, honestly.
lines.zh: ：说实话，我并不真的清楚我的计划是什么。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya5
: I wanted to avoid him a little while longer after catching him fucking my little sister, but I’m just as pathetic as the rest of you at the end of the day.
lines.zh: ：撞见他在操我妹妹之后，我本想再避他一阵子，可说到底我跟你们其他人一样可悲。

lines.en: : I’m not sure why, but I just can’t give up on him. Some sort of childhood friend obligation or something, maybe. What’s the case for you?
lines.zh: ：我不太清楚为什么，可我就是没法放弃他。也许是某种青梅竹马的义务感之类的。你又是为什么呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: ：你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean why do you seem so attached to him when you’ve only known him for a few years?
lines.zh: ：我是说，你明明才认识他几年，为什么看起来这么黏他？

lines.en: : You know nothing about how long I’ve known him.
lines.zh: ：你根本不知道我认识他多久了。

lines.en: : Right, but even if he was in the fucking room when you were born, I’ve still known him longer. It’s probably just sunk cost fallacy keeping me going at this point. Why you, though?
lines.zh: ：对，但就算你出生的时候他他妈就在那间房里，我认识他也还是更久。到现在大概只是沉没成本谬误在推着我走。可你又是为什么呢？

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya6
: Especially now. This obviously isn’t the fairytale romance you were led to believe it was.
lines.zh: ：尤其现在。这显然不是你以为的那种童话爱情。

lines.en: : It’s never been a fairytale. But...it was better. Before you came back. Before your sister came back. Before anyone else was fighting for him at all.
lines.zh: ：它从来就不是童话。但……它曾经更好。在你回来之前。在你妹妹回来之前。在还没有任何人为他争抢之前。

lines.en: : Are you saying you’re ground zero then? Is that why he called you different?
lines.zh: ：所以你是说你是起点咯？这就是他说你「不一样」的原因？

lines.en: : Well, that’s annoying. When? How old were you?
lines.zh: ：好吧，那真讨厌。什么时候？你当时多大？

lines.en: : I’m not going to answer that question.
lines.zh: ：这个问题我不会回答。

lines.en: : You’re barely answering any of my questions. I-
lines.zh: ：你几乎什么问题都不回答。我——

lines.en: : I have no reason to. You already won. And I’m not going to give you the satisfaction of leeching further joy from how miserable and hopeless I feel in your presence.
lines.zh: ：我没有理由回答。你已经赢了。而我不会给你那份满足感，让你从我在你面前有多可悲、多绝望里再榨取一点乐趣。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya7
: But you’re not going to back down either, are you? Which means I haven’t exactly “won,” have I?
lines.zh: ：可你也不会退让，对吧？这意味着我并不算真的「赢了」，不是吗？

lines.en: : You’ve won as much as anyone can win with him. And if you lined the two of us up and forced him to choose, I am well aware that I’d be leaving here empty-handed.
lines.zh: ：在他这件事上，你已经赢到了任何人能赢的极限。而如果你把我们俩排成一排逼他选，我很清楚我会空着手离开这里。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya8
: Hey, you’re more confident than me then. I’m pretty sure that basically half of the people I’ve talked to over the last couple days had sex with Akira before I did.
lines.zh: ：嘿，那你比我有信心多了。我挺确定过去这几天我跟聊过的人里，有一半在跟我之前就已经跟 Akira 上过床了。

lines.en: : And you’re probably right...but that’s not as important as you might think. Or...how I thought for a while.
lines.zh: ：你大概说得没错……但那没你想的那么重要。或者说……我曾一度那么以为。

lines.en: : I’m not really in the mood for an anecdote about your experiences as a teenager struggling to take a footlong dick, thanks.
lines.zh: ：我现在没什么心情听你讲一个十几岁少女艰难吞下一根一英尺长鸡巴的经历，谢谢。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya9
: If you’re going to fucking talk to me, will you at least hear me?! Because I might just be another stupid kid to you, but I’ve been dreading this confrontation for years!
lines.zh: ：如果你他妈要跟我说话，能不能至少听我说？！因为对你来说我可能只是又一个蠢小孩，可这场对峙我已经害怕了好几年！

lines.en: : And all you’re doing is just making it feel like I’m part of some to-do list where you go through a lineup of all the girls fucking your boyfriend and say, “Please stop, for I am better.”
lines.zh: ：而你做的只是让这感觉像是我在某个待办清单上——你把所有操你男朋友的女孩排成一排，然后说：「请停下吧，因为我更优秀。」

lines.en: : Okay. Then please do give me the anecdote about you struggling to take a footlong dick. I would very much love to hear it.
lines.zh: ：好。那就请你真的给我讲讲你艰难吞下一英尺长鸡巴的经历吧。我非常乐意听。

lines.en: : He could be a fucking eunuch for all I care! All I want is for him to look at me the way he used to! But every fucking day, that dream gets bigger and more distant because people like you keep blocking out the fucking sun!
lines.zh: ：他就算是个他妈的太监我都不在乎！我只想让他像从前那样看着我！可每一天，那个梦想都变得更大更遥远，因为像你这样的人一直在把太阳遮住！

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya10
: Blocking out the sun? You think we have access to the fucking sun? Here? In a world where we’re all fighting over the same broken sexpest who has never given any of us anything?
lines.zh: ：遮住太阳？你以为我们碰得到那该死的太阳？在这里？在一个我们全在为同一个可悲的性害虫争抢，而他从没给过我们任何人任何东西的世界里？

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya11
: Never given us anything?! He has given me everything! These clothes! My bell! A place to sleep! And he did it all without your help! Just like he can do for Ami!
lines.zh: ：从没给过我们东西？！他给了我一切！这些衣服！我的铃铛！一个睡觉的地方！而这一切都不是靠你帮忙！他同样也能为 Ami 做到！

lines.en: : Everything I am is because of him! So of course I’m going to continue to love him even when I’m losing! There’s no alternative! It’s always just been him!
lines.zh: ：我所有的一切都是因为他！所以我当然会继续爱他，哪怕我是在输！没有别的选择！从来都只有他！

lines.en: : And I thought that out of everyone, you would get that! But instead, I’m just exactly what I thought I’ve been to you this entire time! Another bump in the road that you’re too distracted to even notice!
lines.zh: ：而我以为在所有人里，你会明白这一点！可结果我只是我一直以为自己在你眼里是的东西！路上的一块绊脚石，你分心到根本注意不到！

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how much I fear you?! The dread that seeps into every minute of every day?! Every second I spend without a response to my messages or calls?!
lines.zh: ：你知不知道我有多怕你？！那种渗进每一天每一分钟的恐惧？！我每一条消息、每一通电话得不到回应时度过的每一秒？！

lines.en: : It all goes back to you, Niki! But I bet you don’t even fucking know my name! And why would you when I was supposed to be a secret?!
lines.zh: ：这一切都归到你身上，Niki！可我敢打赌你连我的名字都他妈的不知道！你当然不知道，因为我本该是个秘密？！

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya12

: But now you’re posting pictures on fucking Instagram and bragging about the “love of your life” to the entire world like you’re the lead in a fucking rom-com when my entire world is just psychological horror and drama!
lines.zh: ：可现在你在他妈的 Instagram 上发照片，跟全世界炫耀「你一生的爱」，好像你是他妈的爱情喜剧主角，而我的整个世界却只是心理恐怖和狗血剧！

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya13
: Aren’t you supposed to be good?! Or at least good for him?! And not some fucking tsundere robot who shows up and just shits on him and everyone else so you can regain control of your life?!
lines.zh: ：你不是应该很善良吗？！或者至少对他好？！而不是一个他妈的傲娇机器人，冒出来就对我和所有人拉屎，好夺回自己人生的控制权？！

lines.en: : Never given us anything?! Really?! You’re going to take him back as easily as you did and then say something like that?! Would it kill you to be fucking honest with yourself?!
lines.zh: ：从没给过我们东西？！真的吗？！你就这么轻易地把他接回去，然后说这种话？！你能不能他妈的对自己诚实一点？！

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya14
: It almost did once. When he ran away without even sparing me a warning. But that’s not information you’re going to find when you look me up online.
lines.zh: ：有一次差点要了我的命。当他一声不响地逃走的时候。但那不是你在网上搜我会找到的信息。

lines.en: : He ran away to save you! From this! So don’t blame him now that you’re back and things fucking suck! Of course they suck! They were always going to suck the moment Ami’s mom died!
lines.zh: ：他逃走是为了救你！为了让你远离这一切！所以现在你回来了、事情糟透了，别怪他！当然糟！从 Ami 的妈妈死的那一刻起，一切就注定要糟糕！

lines.en: : So you know about her too then?
lines.zh: ：所以你也知道她的事？

lines.en: : I know everything...
lines.zh: ：我什么都知道……

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya15
: I’m ground zero.
lines.zh: ：我是起点。

lines.en: scene black
scene dormwarssixmaya16
: And you can look at me as the catalyst to all of this if you want. That’s what everyone has been fucking doing lately. Probably Akira too.
lines.zh: ：你大可以把我看作这一切的催化剂，如果你想的话。这就是最近所有人他妈的都在做的事。大概 Akira 也是。

lines.en: : But put yourself in my shoes. Imagine having nothing. Being nothing.
lines.zh: ：但你换到我的位置上想想。想象一无所有。什么都不是。

lines.en: : And then suddenly...there’s this lonely, desperate man, barely clinging to life, who still manages to reach out and help you because, beneath all of the pain and suffering, he wants to be good.
lines.zh: ：然后突然……出现了一个孤独、绝望的男人，勉强吊着命，却还是设法伸出手帮你，因为在所有痛苦与折磨之下，他想要善良。

lines.en: : He wants to love and be loved, but doesn’t know how because it all just hurts so much when it goes away. And it does go away. We’ve seen it with our own eyes and felt it in our hearts.
lines.zh: ：他想爱，也想被爱，但他不知道怎么做，因为当这一切离开时实在太痛了。而它确实会离开。我们亲眼见过，也亲身感受过。

lines.en: : You’re making him sound like some sort of saint. He’s a terrible man who needs help and we both know it.
lines.zh: ：你说得他像个圣人一样。他是个需要帮助的糟糕男人，我们俩都清楚。

lines.en: : We do. But the difference between you and me is that I only insult him to his face and you just want someone to validate you and make you feel like you haven’t wasted your entire life.
lines.zh: ：我们都清楚。但你我的差别在于，我只当着他的面侮辱他，而你只是想让某个人认可你，让你觉得自己没白活一辈子。

lines.en: : So you’re probably doing this to everybody. Not just me. Then going back to him and tightening his collar while he stands there just innocently wanting you to be by his side despite his flaws.
lines.zh: ：所以你大概对所有人都这么做。不只对我。然后再回到他身边，收紧他的项圈，而他就那么无辜地站在那儿，尽管满是缺陷，还是想让你陪在他身边。

lines.en: : He fucked my little sister. In front of me.
lines.zh: ：他操了我妹妹。就在我面前。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya17
: He could fuck the entire city of Kumon-mi in front of me and I still wouldn’t give up on him the way you have!
lines.zh: ：他就算当着我的面操遍整个 Kumon-mi 城，我也绝不会像你这样放弃他！

lines.en: : What?! Say something! Make me feel small again!
lines.zh: ：什么？！说点什么！再让我觉得自己渺小！

lines.en: : Girls like you are seriously the worst.
lines.zh: ：像你这样的女孩真是糟透了。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya18
: What?
lines.zh: ：什么？

lines.en: : It should be so fucking easy to just show up and be like, “Hi, I’m Niki Nakayama. You’re a teenager that’s fucking my boyfriend and that’s gross and not cool.”
lines.zh: ：本来应该他妈的很简单的，就是出现然后说：「嗨，我是 Niki Nakayama。你是个正在操我男朋友的未成年，这很恶心，很不像话。」

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya19
: But then girls like you or Noriko explain it in a way where it actually starts to make sense. That’s what sucks.
lines.zh: ：可接着像你或 Noriko 这样的女孩会把它解释得居然开始说得通。这才是最糟的。

lines.en: : You keep robbing me of reasons to lose faith in him and perpetuating the cycle where he and I wind up together and the rest of you feel bad.
lines.zh: ：你们一直剥夺我对他失去信心的理由，还让这个循环持续下去——他和我最后走到一起，而你们其余人伤心难过。

lines.en: : I...don’t really get it.
lines.zh: ：我……不太明白。

lines.en: : Because you think I’ve actually given up on him. That the reason I’m going out of my way to talk to all of you is to try and make you all feel weak and stupid. And that’s not true.
lines.zh: ：因为你以为我真的放弃他了。以为我特意去跟你们每个人说话，是为了让你们全都觉得自己软弱愚蠢。而那并不是真的。

lines.en: : Well, I guess there’s an ounce of truth to it. But what I really want to do is-
lines.zh: ：好吧，我猜这里面有那么一丁点是真的。但我真正想做的是——

lines.en: : To figure out how things became the way they are...
lines.zh: ：是搞清楚事情怎么变成了现在这样……

lines.en: : To see just how far he’s fallen and if there’s any hope for him at all.
lines.zh: ：是看看他究竟堕落到了什么程度，以及他是否还任何一点希望。

lines.en: : What I don’t get is the outcome you’re seeking. Do you want a reason to have faith in him? Or do you want a reason to lose it?
lines.zh: ：我不明白的是你想求的结果。你是想要一个对他保有信心的理由？还是想要一个对他失去信心的理由？

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya20
: Did he really take you in when you had nowhere else to go?
lines.zh: ：他真的是在你无处可去的时候收留了你吗？

lines.en: : I’m guessing you’re the one who made the first move too then, aren’t you?
lines.zh: ：那我猜主动的也是你，对吧？

lines.en: : Did something give it away?
lines.zh: ：有什么露馅了吗？

lines.en: : Just the fact that it’s what I’d least want to hear.
lines.zh: ：只因为那是我最不想听到的答案。

lines.en: : Then yes, I did. And I’d do it again too.
lines.zh: ：那么是的，是我。而且我还会再做一次。

lines.en: : Because no matter how terrible you make me feel and no matter how badly you will ultimately defeat me, he is the one I want.
lines.zh: ：因为不管你让我觉得自己多糟，不管你最终会把我击败得多惨，他都是我想要的那个人。

lines.en: : And he will stay that way until the end of time...
lines.zh: ：而他会一直如此，直到时间的尽头……

lines.en: : What’s your name again?
lines.zh: ：你叫什么名字来着？

lines.en: : Maya. Maya Makinami.
lines.zh: ：Maya。Maya Makinami。

lines.en: : Have you ever considered becoming an idol?
lines.zh: ：你有没有考虑过当偶像？

lines.en: : Not even once.
lines.zh: ：一次都没有。

lines.en: : Good. Don’t. You wouldn’t make it.
lines.zh: ：很好。别去。你成不了的。

lines.en: : Thank you for finally saying something nice to me. Can I take that as the conversation being over?
lines.zh: ：谢谢你终于对我说了句好话。我可以把这理解为对话结束了吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: ：不行。

lines.en: scene dormwarssixmaya21
: There’s a konbini around the corner. How about I buy you a drink?
lines.zh: ：拐角有家便利店。我请你喝点东西怎么样？

lines.en: : I figure it’s the least I can do after making you live your life in fear for so long.
lines.zh: ：我想，让你在恐惧里活了这么久之后，这至少是我能做的。

lines.en: : And probably a good chance for me to learn some stuff about Ami that she wouldn’t tell me otherwise. If you’re actually willing to talk, that is.
lines.zh: ：大概也是我打听一些 Ami 不会告诉我的事的好机会。前提是你真的愿意聊的话。

lines.en: : You’re...offering to buy me a drink?
lines.zh: ：你……要请我喝东西？

lines.en: : Yeah. You seem smart, so I figured you’d have picked up on that.
lines.zh: ：对。你看起来挺聪明的，我以为你会自己领会到。

lines.en: : That’s...not really the direction I thought this conversation was going in. You don’t think I like you, do you?
lines.zh: ：这……不是我以为这场对话会走的方向。你不会以为我喜欢你吧？

lines.en: : No, and I don’t like you either. Do we really need to like each other to just go for a walk, though?
lines.zh: ：不会，我也不喜欢你。可我们就非得互相喜欢才能一起散个步吗？

lines.en: : I...guess not? But still, I-
lines.zh: ：我……大概不必吧？不过还是，我——

lines.en: scene black
: Come on. It’s not often I offer to buy someone a drink.
lines.zh: ：来吧。我可不常请人喝东西。

lines.en: : Do you want a mask? So the paparazzi leave us alone?
lines.zh: ：你要口罩吗？这样狗仔就不会来烦我们了。

lines.en: : I...need to wear one too?
lines.zh: ：我……也需要戴一个？

lines.en: : Probably not. Wouldn’t hurt, though, right?
lines.zh: ：大概不用。不过戴了也无妨，对吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...o...okay?
lines.zh: ：呃……好……好吧？

lines.en: : I just...don’t you...isn’t Akira waiting for you inside?
lines.zh: ：我只是……你不是……Akira 不是在里头等你吗？

lines.en: if nodokathontwo3 == True:
: He’s probably forgotten all about me by now. I just hope he’s standing in the corner all sad instead of going against my orders again.
lines.zh: ：他现在大概已经把我忘光了。我只希望他乖乖站在角落里垂头丧气，而不是又一次违抗我的命令。

lines.en: $ dormwarssixmaya1 = True
jump dormwarssixsara1
else:
: Yeah, so? Making him wait is just my way of training him.
lines.zh: ：是啊，那又怎样？让他等着，就是我训练他的方式。

lines.en: : He’s not your pet...
lines.zh: ：他不是你的宠物……

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because you’re his.
lines.zh: ：你这么说只因为你是他的。

lines.en: : W...Willingly! You forgot to mention the “willingly” part!
lines.zh: ：我、我是自愿的！你忘了说「自愿」那部分！

lines.en: : Just shut up and put this on.
lines.zh: ：闭嘴，把这个戴上。

lines.en: Somehow or another, things ended up like this.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，事情就变成了这样。

lines.en: The game of Rampage ends with a building still standing — though whether that’s a glitch or a creative decision remains to be determined.
lines.zh: 《Rampage》这局游戏结束时，还有一栋楼立着——不过这究竟是漏洞还是刻意的设计，尚无定论。

lines.en: There is one thing for certain, though.
lines.zh: 但有一件事是确定的。

lines.en: Maya Makinami still feels insignificant — for she would never offer up an olive branch like this. Nor would she take one from the other girl who lives in the shadow of the mountain.
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 依然觉得自己无足轻重——因为她绝不会主动递出这样一根橄榄枝。她也不会从那个生活在山影之下的另一个女孩手里接过一根。

lines.en: For a moment, though, she feels regretful. Remorseful. And worse about herself than she has in a long time.
lines.zh: 不过有那么一刻，她感到懊悔。悔恨。而且比很久以来任何时候都更厌恶自己。

lines.en: These feelings would only get worse over time.
lines.zh: 这些感觉只会随着时间越来越糟。

lines.en: There was only one war that ended tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚结束的，只有一场战争。
